title: Divergence — structural placeholder
description: Visible distinction of incompatible consequential streams without silently assigning one current State to both.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

predecessor_relation.description: Supported earlier relation or shared material, if established; resemblance alone supplies no ancestry.

streams.description: Exact incompatible consequential streams and their separately supported States.

scope.description: Target, layer, and Localities at which divergence is held.

boundary.description: Supported occurrence or interval at which incompatibility is established.

incompatibility.description: Exact conflict without erasure of either supported history.

classification.description: Supported divergence or unresolved classification; shared lineage cannot conceal changed identity commitments.

treatment.description: Valid reconciliation, visible conflict, or recognition as distinct continuities, with its basis.

remaining_uncertainty.description: Questions not resolved by classification or reconciliation at this scope.
